subject: Pricing: Dedicated GPU package & strategic credit request (Stratus Labs)
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@stratus.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity — pricing ask

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Redwood Dedicated performance looked great. We're close to a decision but I need to flag a competing offer from NimbusAI: 30% off list on a 24-month reserved commit for a 64-GPU pool plus six weeks of free onboarding credits.

Stratus is preparing a production-heavy inference pipeline and throughput guarantees are decisive for us. To move ahead with Redwood we need either: (a) a match to the pricing package (30% + onboarding credit) or (b) a meaningful one-time credit that offsets the delta while we lock a 24-month commit.

Can you share what flexibility you have on pricing and one-time credits? Also, we'll need clarified throughput SLAs (p95 token latency target per GPU) and whether burst capacity is included in the reserved pool. Procurement is on copy — we need a clear commercial proposal to present internally by Friday.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Platform
Stratus Labs

---
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@stratus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity — pricing ask

Hi Elena — really appreciate the transparency and the timeline. Quick summary from our side:

- We can meet the throughput profile you demoed (baseline p95 token latency target across your workload) when pinned to our 64-GPU pool with continuous batching and prefix caching enabled.
- Burst capacity: we can offer a configurable burst bucket for short windows (subject to capacity). We typically carve ~10% burst capacity on top of reserved pools for our dedicated customers.

On pricing: we don't do a straight list-match policy, but for strategic accounts we're able to provide a combination of a deeper committed discount and a one-time onboarding credit. To make this fast for your procurement team, I'm going to propose two options for you to consider:

Option A — Committed 24 months (64-GPU equivalent): 25% off list + $150,000 one-time onboarding credit.
Option B — Committed 36 months (64-GPU equivalent): 30% off list + $100,000 one-time onboarding credit.

Both options include: dedicated capacity, tooling access, and a throughput SLI we can bake into the SOW (with a fall-back model if we miss the margin—details in SOW). Option B gives you the 30% headline discount but asks for a longer term.

If either of these gets close, I will loop in our finance and revenue leaders to clear a final one-time concession (we usually reserve that for exec sign-off). I have Marissa on cc to help accelerate the SOW and Marcus will run the numbers. Can you confirm which option your team would prefer and whether procurement needs any additional terms (e.g., data retention, audit logs)?

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW_Stratus_2027_v1.pdf (draft SOW, throughput SLI placeholder)

---
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Stratus pricing request — recommendation for credit/discount approval

Team — forwarding Stratus' ask. Quick context:
- Account: Stratus Labs (strategic prospect, strong chance to expand into other infra teams).
- Competing offer: NimbusAI at 30% + onboarding credit.
- Grace's suggested commercial choices (sent to customer): 25% + $150k (24m) or 30% + $100k (36m).

My recommendation: approve up to a $200k one-time concession OR move to 25% immediate discount + $200k credit if we can get a 24-month commit with a 6-month true-up clause (measures actual throughput). Rationale:
- Stratus is high-visibility and could be a reference across infra workloads.
- Losing to Nimbus would be both revenue and positioning loss.
- The $200k credit can be structured as non-recurring onboarding credits (applied to first invoices) and does not change list pricing.

Requesting: Vivek — can you sign off on discretionary credit up to $200k? Marcus — please confirm that a 25% discount + $200k credit is within margin guardrails assuming a 24-month commit for the 64-GPU profile. Marissa — please prep the SOW variant that includes burst bucket and SLI language.

Attachments: Stratus_pricing_model.xlsx

Thanks,
Grace

---
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Stratus pricing request — recommendation for credit/discount approval

Grace — I'm fine approving a structured concession here given the strategic upside, with the following constraints:

1) Max one-time credit: $200,000 (to be booked as non-recurring revenue credit, finance to sign-off).
2) Acceptable discount: up to 25% on list for a 24-month commit. A 30% discount requires a 36-month commit and CFO pre-approval; don't promise 30% yet.
3) We need a 6-month true-up clause: if average committed utilization drops >20% vs. forecast, the credit is clawed back pro-rata.
4) Legal to include a performance SLI (p95 latency targets) and an operational outage remedy — accept SLI credits but limited in aggregate.

If Stratus will sign a 24-month deal with our 25% + $200k credit structure and accept the true-up clause, approve and close. Marcus — please send a short margin sign-off reply so we can finalize the term sheet. Marissa — work with Grace to get the SOW to procurement and include the SLI language.

Vivek
VP, Sales Operations

---
From: Elena Park <elena@stratus.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Stratus Labs Procurement <procurement@stratus.ai>
Date: 2027-08-03T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing: Dedicated GPU package & strategic credit request (Stratus Labs)

Grace — thanks for moving quickly and for the internal escalation. We reviewed the options and procurement will accept Option A if Redwood will commit to the following:

- 24-month reserved commit for the 64-GPU pool
- 25% discount off list
- $200,000 onboarding credit applied to the first two invoices
- 6-month true-up clause as described (fair)
- Include burst bucket (10%) and the p95 SLI in SOW

If you can share the final term sheet and updated SOW with the SLI and credit language today, procurement will put it on the internal agenda for Friday approval.

We can sign an LOI in advance to lock terms. Appreciate the flexibility — excited to get started.

Best,
Elena
Head of Platform, Stratus Labs

Attachments referenced in thread: SOW_Stratus_2027_v1.pdf (draft), Stratus_pricing_model.xlsx (financials)
